reply_text:
Checking how Matrix turns are keyed, so the spec can name the right filter instead of leaving it to Codex.Now the store filter and its test.Room scoping is live: the proxy is restarted and the turn store reloaded, and the demo room lists its 8 turns. Next I'm updating the spec so Codex can take it as written.㊥ (Element handoff ready) The Codex handoff is ready. Your Codex in the fork runs outside Agency, so I can't bell it, and you'll need to paste this to it: **"Read `/home/joe/code/futon3c/packages/xiang-client/ELEMENT-FAST-MODE.md` and implement items 4 then 1 as its Handoff section says."** I've dropped the correction feature from the spec. The spec is committed as futon3c `98260423` and pushed.

㊢ (what the spec asks for) There are two commits in `element-web-futon`, item 4 first, because item 1 builds on the call sites it changes:
- **Item 4:** one poller per room instead of a 10-second timer on every message. It fetches a turn's details only when its status changes, and stops once the turn is final. The author scan runs only for Marimo requests.
- **Item 1:** a turn's marks come from 象's analysis if it has arrived, otherwise from 小象's draft, otherwise from the lexical cues. Draft marks are dotted and labelled 小象. Marks the author typed are drawn solid. Unsure fragments show "?" with their two guesses.
- **Checks:**
  - lint, the vitest unit tests for `src/customisations/`, and `build-futon.sh` must pass;
  - then a manual check that 小象 marks appear within seconds and give way to 象's;
  - and that the turn list is requested once per 10 s per room.

㊩ (found while writing it) The chat proxy let any member of the room read every session's turns, including your Emacs turns. Two things leaked:
- The turn list returned the newest 300 turns from all sessions, with full text.
- Any turn could be fetched by its id.

Matrix turns record their room only in `surface` (`matrix (<room-id>)`), so I scoped the proxy by that field. The list now returns only the verified room's turns, without `source-text`, and a turn from another surface reads as not found. This also removes the room-filter question from item 4.
- Committed as futon3c `67758c73` and pushed.
- The `xiang-chat` service is restarted and the turn store is reloaded in the JVM; the demo room lists its 8 turns.
- Two new proxy tests both fail when the filter is removed. I ran them by hand because pytest isn't installed for this Python.

🈳 (still to do on my side)
- The Agency route doesn't pass `surface` through to the store yet. For now the proxy also filters the response itself, so nothing leaks, but `limit` counts turns before that filter. I'll add the one line to `http.clj` once kimi-3 commits its own edit to that file.
- I'm still parked on kimi-1 (marks in the draft) and kimi-3 (no 象 analysis of agent replies), and will review each when it reports back.

previous_reply_acts.text:
(items 2 and 3)
- **kimi-1, 小象 drafts use typed marks.** Job `invoke-1790978909344-30581-356b2721`, park `park-541c2e84…`.
  - A fragment in a paragraph that opens with a mark gets that mark's intent, flagged `basis: "declared"`. So `🈸 yes please do that` becomes ask-action instead of approve.
  - It reuses the mark parser already in `xiaoxiang.py`, and a test checks that file's mark table against the Clojure `proforma-marks` table.
- **kimi-3, bridges stop asking 象 to analyse agent replies.** Job `invoke-1790978920029-30582-54dbdb75`, park `park-b774127d…`.
  - Replies are still recorded with their own `proforma_marks`, but no 象 job is started for them. They must also not sit as "requested", where a retry would dispatch them later.
  - Following the wr-26 card you attached, the switch comment must say why it is off and when to turn it back on. Your 2 October decision is recorded there, and `FUTON3C_XIANG_AGENT_DISPATCH=1` turns it back on.
  - Deploying to the bridge on lucy and reloading the JVM stay with me, after review.

previous_reply_acts.text:
(the Element spec) For the Codex in `element-web-futon`:
- **Item 1: show the draft first.** The order becomes analysis, then the 小象 draft, then lexical cues. Draft marks get a dotted style labelled 小象, so they are never mistaken for 象's reading, and unsure fragments show "?" with two guesses.
- **Item 4: poll once per room.** One poller per room replaces the per-message 10-second timers. It fetches a turn's detail only when that turn's status changes, and the author scan runs only for Marimo requests.
